# Ritesh Patil — AI/ML Engineer & Generative AI Developer

> Official portfolio of Ritesh Patil, an AI/ML Engineer and Generative AI Developer based in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

## Who is Ritesh Patil?

Ritesh Patil is an AI/ML Engineer and Generative AI Developer from Pune, India, currently working as an AI Engineer at Abhiyanta India Solutions. He has 3+ years of hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems — including RAG pipelines, Agentic AI workflows, Computer Vision solutions, and Cloud-Native AI deployments. He bridges the gap between AI research and real-world enterprise applications.

## Core Expertise

- **Generative AI & RAG Systems**: LangChain, LangGraph, Ollama, OpenAI GPT-4, FAISS, Pinecone, Prompt Engineering, RAG pipeline architecture
- **Agentic AI**: Multi-agent orchestration, tool-calling agents, autonomous AI workflows, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate
- **Computer Vision & ML**: YOLO (v8/v11), TensorFlow, OpenCV, Roboflow, TensorFlow Lite, medical imaging
- **Cloud & MLOps**: AWS EC2, AWS SageMaker, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, SAP AI Core, SAP BTP
- **Enterprise AI Integration**: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Dataverse, M365 (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint)
- **Languages & Frameworks**: Python, FastAPI, Angular, Node.js, Express.js

## Notable Projects

### 1. Master Data Repository & Governance Platform — Enterprise Data Management & SAP BTP
Enterprise master-data governance platform engineered on SAP BTP for centralized data management, validation, approval, and downstream S/4HANA syndication. Built with SAP CAP, Node.js, CDS, SAP HANA Cloud, XSUAA, and SAP Build Process Automation. Features a metadata-driven architecture handling dynamic validation and multi-algorithm duplicate detection (Levenshtein, Dice, Soundex).

### 2. CEO-Tower — Generative AI & Financial Intelligence
Enterprise Generative AI and Financial Intelligence Platform. Designed for executive-level decision support integrating financial data from Zoho Books APIs. Built with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, Llama.cpp, and RAG. Features local LLM inference for data privacy, conversational memory via Supabase, and real-time token streaming.

### 3. Industrial Object Detection & Quality Inspection — Computer Vision & Edge Deployment
Real-time computer vision system for automated industrial defect detection and offline inspection. Trained models using YOLO on AWS SageMaker, converted to TensorFlow Lite, and deployed to Android edge devices for real-time inference without internet connectivity.

### 4. Multimodal RAG Chatbot — Document Intelligence & Conversational AI
A document and image-aware retrieval-augmented generation system with conversational memory. Built with Ollama, Llama 2 7B, Nomic Embeddings, FAISS, and LangGraph. Processes both text PDFs and image-based documents using OCR, maintaining multi-turn context with SQLite.

### 5. Medical Knowledge RAG Chatbot — Healthcare AI
A retrieval-augmented medical question-answering system grounded in a large medical knowledge base. Built with GPT-4, LangChain, Sentence Transformers, and Pinecone. Deployed using Docker containers on AWS EC2. Provides source citations to eliminate medical hallucination.

### 6. Virtual Kiosk — EdTech Offline Learning Platform
Offline-first educational platform serving rural and low-connectivity areas. Built with Angular, Node.js, and Express.js and packaged as a standalone executable via pkg. Features JSON-based routing for configurable learning paths without internet dependency.
